about: One row per opponent property that grows with tier (see modes.json). Each row generates one ScaleDef. Opponent stat levels are capped at 3 by the game, so later tiers multiply the opponent team's own stat values instead. Opponent perks are set in teams.json (opponent_perks).

columns.per_tier: added per tier (multiplier fraction for stat/move_speed, count for techniques)
columns.verified: how it was seen working, or 'no'

opponent_techniques.about: Vanilla Techniques that may join an opponent's random perks alongside Overtime perks marked opponent_ok. Preflight rejects any that use the shared 'timer' field or player-only global state.
